title: Private tenancy phasing playbook: quarterly activation calendar & interlock map
creator: Lina Moreno
description: Purpose: produce a single, executable quarterly playbook that sequences feature gating, engineering deliverables, and customer activation windows for Private/VPC/on‑prem tenants. This ticket captures milestones, cross‑team interlocks, canary/cutover cadence, and the OKR mapping needed to operationalize upgrades and new private features in Q2 2026. Scope: staging and production phasing for private control plane changes, KMS/HSM rollout for tenant keys, compatibility checks for customer networking (VPN, Direct Connect equivalents), upgrade rollback playbooks, and the telemetry & acceptance signals that unblock each tranche. Out of scope: hosted API-only changes, marketing collateral, and non-enterprise self-serve flows.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A week-by-week activation calendar for Q2 with named owners for each window. 2) Interlock map listing required engineering PRs, console features, and SRE runbooks with dates. 3) Clear gating metrics: <Time-to-Enable> <= 3 business days, <Upgrade Failure Rate> < 0.5% for canaries, and <First 7-day Stability> meeting SLOs. 4) Draft rollback and backout runbooks validated by SRE in staging. 5) Customer readiness checklist (network, DNS, certs, KMS). 6) OKR mapping: each tranche must show the primary OKR metric and how we measure it in dashboards.
